Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: What is a model breakdown and how could a residual plot reveal it?
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: Model breakdown means the assumed relation fails for new conditions or is systematically misspecified; curved residual patterns warn against a single linear fit.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: What is interpolation within a data sample?
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: Predicting y for x inside the observed x-range.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: What is extrapolation and why may it be unreliable?
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: Predicting outside observed x-range; trend may not continue.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: Explain differences between r>0 and r<0 for a scatterplot.
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: Positive r means upward association, negative r downward association.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: What does |r| near 1 versus near 0 mean?
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: Magnitude near 1 implies strong linear association, near0 weak linear association; neither proves causation.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: An independently reported regression model has slope −1.341, intercept 32.234 and r=−0.896. Predict y at x=11 and interpret correlation sign.
Items.TeacherExpectedMathematicsAndAnalysis: ŷ(11)=−1.341×11+32.234=17.483; r negative strong linear association.

Items.IndependentFirstPartyStudentQuestion: A tree age model has slope 6.301 years/inch, intercept −1.044 years and reported r=−0.970. Predict age at 10 inches and identify any apparent inconsistency.
